recall.question: A towel hangs folded over one bar so its two halves touch. You spread it over two bars instead. In the lesson's model, what happens to its exposed area?
recall.why: Faces pressed together are hidden from the air. Separating them restores those faces: the exposed fraction goes from 0.5 to 1, a doubling. This is area bookkeeping, not a drying time.
